title: Co-op with 3 and 4 players (DPC 0.9.172-dev2, Camera Distance 2.9.11-dev1)
intro: Four controllers, all awake (press a button on each now). A full party (three pawns), open ground, no enemies, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Enough hands, or hand controllers round when a step asks. About 4 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or 'off')
probes.np: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.np_count and D.R.np_count() or 0
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t = {}; for _, p in ipairs(_G.DPC_API.players()) do t[#t + 1] = 'P' .. p.player .. ' ' .. tostring(p.info and p.info.name or (p.info and p.info.is_arisen and 'Arisen') or '?') .. (p.controller_lost and ' (lost)' or '') end; return table.concat(t, ' / ')
probes.nfr: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return 0 end; local m = nil; for _, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do if sl.active then m = math.min(m or 1e9, sl.frames or 0) end end; return m or 0
probes.nerr: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return 0 end; local e = 0; for _, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do e = e + (sl.errors or 0) + ((sl.in_err and 1) or 0) + ((sl.failed and 100) or 0) end; return e + ((D.R.np.err and 1000) or 0)
probes.lost: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return 0 end; local n = 0; for _, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do if sl.pad_lost then n = n + 1 end end; return n
probes.lway: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local L = D and D.R.lis; return L and (L.found or (L.failed and 'failed') or 'finding') or ''
probes.ai0: local p = H.pawn(0); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.ai1: local p = H.pawn(1); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.ai2: local p = H.pawn(2); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro): four controllers awake. Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until 'player 2 joined'. 20 seconds.
PLAYER 3: hold L3 + R3 (both stick clicks) on your controller until 'player 3 joined'. 15 seconds.
PLAYER 4: hold L3 + R3 until 'player 4 joined'. 15 seconds.
EVERYONE: walk your own character around, attack, use a skill. Each controller moves only its own character? Camera keeps all four in view? 25 seconds.
PLAYER 3: press L1 + left stick click. Everyone's character is taken, so player 3 should stay ('nobody else to take').
Three tough goblins. Everyone fights for 25 seconds. Sound: can you hear everyone with the camera pulled back?

expect.label: the sound listener found a way to move

steps.text: PLAYER 4: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds: player 4 leaves (co-op goes on). 10 seconds.
PLAYER 3: press L1 + left stick click: player 3 moves to the pawn player 4 left. 10 seconds.
Optional: switch PLAYER 3's controller off (or unplug it) for a few seconds, switch it on, press a button on it: player 3 gets it back ('controller is back'). 25 seconds.
PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op (players 2 and 3 end too).
Done. Tell Claude: did each controller drive only its own character? Camera with four? Bars for P3 / P4 readable? Sound?
